title: More recipes
description: Adds many Quality of Life crafting recipes to make minecraft survival and building less of a hassle
body:
# More Recipes : Crafting made easy

Making crafting less of a speedbump to your creativity !

## **Features**

- **✓ Adds many unpacking and packing recipes for many materials (amethyst, magma, clay...)**
- **✓ Adds smelting recipes for raw ore blocks**
- **✓ Keeps vanilla balance : All crfting recipes still cost the same and no uncraftable items are given crafting recipes.**
- **✓ Recipes will be unlocked in your recipe books when you find ingredients for them**
**This datapack is made to increase convenience not make minecraft easy**
